provenance.note: Official CWRU spec pages (bearing-information, fault-specifications) were vacated in a site migration (checked 2026-09-08; pages return nav chrome only) and web.archive.org was unreachable from this network. Constants transcribed from Seong & Kim 2024, Sensors 24(3):776, Tables 2-3 (DOI 10.3390/s24030776), which reproduce the CWRU-documented values; independently re-derived from the geometry formulas (agreement within 0.1%). Before camera-ready, re-verify against an archived copy of the official CWRU page.

formulas_x_shaft_freq.comment: delta = (d/D)*cos(alpha); fr = shaft frequency in Hz

cwru_12k_drive_end.note: use the per-file X*{n}RPM channel when present; fall back to this table

curated_benchmark.or_clock_position: 6 o'clock only; @3/@12 files (144-147,156,158-160,246-249,258-261) excluded from the main grid and reserved as an intra-domain robustness/out-of-coverage probe
curated_benchmark.mapping_officially_verified: 2026-09-08, parsed the official 12k DE page table: columns = Inner Race / Ball / Outer Race @6 Centered / @3 Orthogonal / @12 Opposite; all 36 fault file numbers confirmed

rule_stratification_v2_2026_09_08.method_history: v0 raw Hilbert envelope (bearing_prototype.py, 7/7 fault probe), v1 single max-kurtosis band (bearing_v1.py, 600Hz grid then 400/200), v2 per-component max over 27 bands (bearing_v2.py); diagnostics bearing_diag.py

rule_deterministic_stratum.result: 20/20 correct in v1 AND v2 (BPFI band prominence 124-444, BPFO 241-696; margins >10x over competing components)
rule_deterministic_stratum.rule: bandpass envelope harmonic prominence, argmax over {BPFI->IR, BPFO->OR}

hard_stratum.result: B 1-3/12, OR014 0/4, normal 0-1/4 across v0/v1/v2; raw envelope out-scored by normal files (BSF-family 69-111 vs fault 40-79); max-over-bands reinflates normals
hard_stratum.implication: envelope characteristic-frequency rules are insufficient here; literature concurs (12k DE ball faults weakly modulated). Handle via QCKUR model-handler tier (deterministic supervised classifier on spectral features, e.g. loads 0/1 train -> loads 2/3 test), mirroring the AI4I TWF probabilistic-band design
hard_stratum.next: v3 two-tier handler: rule tier for the deterministic stratum, spectral classifier for the hard stratum; then question bank/KU encoding

rule_tier.fires_IR_if: BPFI prominence >= tau_IR=79.5 AND BPFI/max(BPFO,BALLFAM) >= 2.4 (dominance guard)
rule_tier.calibration: thresholds are geometric midpoints of the gap on loads 0/1 only; the dominance guard is a DISCLOSED post-hoc refinement (first run false-fired IR on 225.mat, ratio 1.6; true-IR min ratio 3.8; midpoint 2.4); guard also correctly routes borderline true-IR files (172, 211) to the model tier
rule_tier.pre_registration_requirement: before the B-system report campaign this exact rule form must be fixed in a dated experiment plan (AI4I plan-v6.0 discipline)

model_tier.features: 16 file-level features: rms/kurt/skew, 6 spectral energy fractions, band-scanned envelope prominences (BPFO/BPFI/BSF/2xBSF/FTF/BALLFAM), max band kurtosis
model_tier.train_test: trained on loads 0/1 (20 files), loads 2/3 are held out

results.main_grid_40: 40/40 (rule 18/18, model 22/22, held-out half 20/20); confusion matrix diagonal 4/12/12/12
results.position_probe_16: 15/16 on unseen OR @3/@12 files (8/8 @3, 7/8 @12; miss = 156.mat->B by model tier); 13/16 fired the rule tier (BPFO 107-466), confirming position-invariance of the BPFO rule
results.corpus_total: 55/56 across the downloaded CWRU 12k DE corpus
